title: The Louvre glowing beneath a stormy Parisian sky.
description: The glass pyramid at the Louvre caught between electric light and a darkening sky, photographed from below as storm clouds gathered over the courtyard.

title: Snow-Capped Peaks of the Bekaa Valley.
description: Fresh snow on the ridge above the valley, lit for a few minutes through a break in low winter cloud before the weather closed in again.

title: Snow and stone on the timeless slopes of Sannine.
description: Late snow breaking up across limestone on the upper slopes of Mount Sannine, where the pattern of melt and rock changes by the hour.
collections: New releases, Landscape, Black and white

title: Golden Horizon Over the High Slopes of Falougha
description: The last band of sunset settling over the ridges above Falougha, with the valleys already gone to shadow below.

title: The Pouring of Red Wine
description: A close-up shot captures rich, dark red wine as a smooth stream flows down from a bottle into a glass against a dark, moody background. The vivid crimson liquid catches light along its stream and forms a gentle layer of delicate, illuminated bubbles at the surface, contrasting sharply with the deep shadows around it.

title: A hundred small prayers, lit one by one
description: Rows of glowing votive candles flicker in the dim light of Sacré-Cœur de Montmartre, a hand reaching in to light another as warm amber glow spills across glass and wax.

title: Where the pines keep their secrets.
description: A quiet pine forest in Falougha, its tall trunks fading into evening mist, with one glowing patch of grass breaking through the shadows.

title: Iron reaching for the storm.
description: A dramatic upward view of the Eiffel Tower's latticework against a heavy, cloud-streaked sky in monochrome.
collections: New releases, Architecture, Urban, Black and white

title: A basilica against the coming storm.
description: Sacré-Cœur's golden domes rise dramatically beneath heavy, brooding clouds, framed by bare winter trees on the Montmartre hillside.
